source_refs.note: The boxes on creationism and spontaneous generation (PDF 215).

blocks.text: According to the theory of creationism ('theory of intelligent design'), all organisms were created as they exist today. Creationists hold that each type of organism was created individually and has not changed throughout history.

Early people also believed that living things can develop from non-living matter, the idea of spontaneous generation. As science progressed, experiments disproved spontaneous generation, but such experiments could not negate creationism.
